mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place ( place_id, member_id, region_id, place_type, name, description, address, mapx, mapy, is_closed, created_at, updated_at, first_image, hashtags, min_price, use_fee_info, people_count, extra_info ) VALUES ( #{placeId}, #{memberId}, #{regionId}, #{placeType}, #{name}, #{description}, #{address}, #{mapx}, #{mapy}, #{isClosed}, NOW(), NOW(), #{firstImage}, #{hashtags}, #{minPrice}, #{useFeeInfo}, #{peopleCount}, #{extraInfo} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE region_id = VALUES(region_id), place_type = VALUES(place_type), name = VALUES(name), description = VALUES(description), address = VALUES(address), mapx = VALUES(mapx), mapy = VALUES(mapy), is_closed = VALUES(is_closed), updated_at = NOW(), first_image = VALUES(first_image), hashtags = VALUES(hashtags), min_price = VALUES(min_price), use_fee_info = VALUES(use_fee_info), people_count = VALUES(people_count), extra_info = VALUES(extra_info);
mapper.select: SELECT place_id AS placeId, member_id AS memberId, region_id AS regionId, place_type AS placeType, name, description, address, mapx, mapy, is_closed AS isClosed, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, first_image AS firstImage, hashtags, min_price AS minPrice, use_fee_info AS useFeeInfo, people_count AS peopleCount, extra_info AS extraInfo FROM place WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
mapper.sql:
WHERE p.is_closed = 0
AND p.place_type = #{placeType}
AND (p.region_id = #{regionId} OR r.parent_region_id = #{regionId})
AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.hashtags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select:
SELECT p.place_id AS placeId, p.member_id AS memberId, p.region_id AS regionId, p.place_type AS placeType, p.name, p.description, p.address, p.mapx, p.mapy, p.is_closed AS isClosed, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.first_image AS firstImage, p.hashtags, p.min_price AS minPrice, p.use_fee_info AS useFeeInfo, p.people_count AS peopleCount, p.extra_info AS extraInfo, r.region_name AS regionName FROM place p LEFT JOIN region r ON p.region_id = r.region_id
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place p LEFT JOIN region r ON p.region_id = r.region_id
SELECT image_id AS imageId, place_id AS placeId, image_url AS imageUrl, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM place_image WHERE place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT region_id AS regionId, region_name AS regionName, parent_region_id AS parentRegionId FROM region WHERE parent_region_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT region_id AS regionId, region_name AS regionName, parent_region_id AS parentRegionId FROM region WHERE parent_region_id IS NULL ORDER BY region_id ASC
